integrity: Exact standalone finite tests accompany a self-contained unrestricted proof. Source access and priority limitations are explicitly stated. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The drift hypothesis is sufficient, not necessary. No classification for sequences with bounded or oscillating drift is claimed; a shifted geometric progression shows failure without the drift. The motivating source original PDF was not accessible and historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Affine rigidity from unbounded exponential drift: Catalan and Fuss–Catalan value sets
